ConnectionStrings._comment: Do NOT put credentials here. Provide DefaultConnection via user-secrets (dev) or environment variable ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection / appsettings.Production.json (prod).

_AllowedHostsNote: Semicolon-separated hostnames the site will serve (host-header hardening). Add the custom domain here when it goes live, e.g. "bardeesrefaat.com;www.bardeesrefaat.com;bardeesrefaat.premiumasp.net".
